description: After weeks of fighting over what should have been an easy decision, the Idaho Legislature yet again shortchanged Idaho’s 20,000 state employees. The approved compensation package by the Republican-dominated Joint Finance Appropriations Committee (JFAC) falls painfully short in addressing the pressing needs of our workforce, compromising our state’s ability to recruit and retain top talent. […]

title: It’s past time to compensate Idaho state employees fairly - Senator Melissa Wintrow For Idaho District 19
